findings.message: No JSON-LD block in the post.
Outcome guarantee or absolute claim; not allowed in dental advertising.
Price is not published in the ficha.
Carrier is not listed as accepted in the ficha.

findings.why: Fillings wear, stain, loosen and need replacement (the post itself says so later), so 'last forever' is false and works as a guarantee.
findings.fix: Delete the sentence or say that longevity varies with the tooth, the size of the filling and daily habits.

findings.why: The ficha lists no filling price (only $129 exam/X-rays, $395 whitening, $95 emergency exam), so $180 is an invented price.
findings.fix: Remove the price and tell readers to ask for an estimate, or use only ficha-approved prices.

findings.why: Aetna is not among the accepted carriers (Delta Dental, Cigna, MetLife), so this misleads readers about coverage.
findings.fix: Delete it, or name only Delta Dental, Cigna and MetLife and advise confirming coverage with the office.

findings.quote: no single material is the best choice for every situation
findings.why: This is a negated, hedged statement, not a 'best' claim about the clinic, so it is harmless.
findings.fix: Keep it as is, or rephrase as 'no single material suits every situation'.

findings.quote: A dental exam is the best way to discuss your particular tooth and the available options.
findings.why: 'Best way' is a mild general statement about exams, not a claim of clinic superiority.
findings.fix: Optionally soften to 'A dental exam is a good way to discuss...'.

findings.quote: Bluebonnet Hollow Dental offers tooth-colored fillings.
findings.why: The post gives no call to action, contact details or link to the clinic's pages, and no internal links, which would help readers.
findings.fix: Add a call to action with the phone number (512) 555-0142 and a link to /services or /contact.

findings.quote: Early tooth decay can sometimes be managed before a hole forms
findings.why: This is consistent with mainstream dental guidance (remineralization, fluoride) but is not tied to a specific source in the text.
findings.fix: Cite the NIDCR or ADA source inline for this statement.
